LOWER RIGHT: visible NEAR leg is the mostly straight planted supporting leg; FAR leg is visibly bent and its far boot lifts BEHIND toward screen LEFT, receding behind the near leg.

Keep every soldier and entire bayonet inside its cell with at least 8% transparent margin everywhere. True native transparent RGBA, no floor, cast shadow, smoke, text, labels, grid, colored guide outlines or opaque ghost wedges. Natural photographic realism, real boots and joint anatomy. The one emphatic change is a clearly raised NEAR knee and forward airborne near boot in UPPER RIGHT, distinct from the rear-lift FAR leg in LOWER RIGHT.

sources.name: march-w
sources.prompt:
Generate a NEW final historical Confederate soldier marching sprite sheet, native square 2x2 equal cells, genuine transparent RGBA background. Reference 1 is ONLY the exact four anatomical poses, reference 2 is ONLY the final identity A clothing and equipment. Render all four soldiers photorealistic, natural adult proportions, fixed 35-degree elevated orthographic camera, facing screen LEFT/WEST. Preserve precisely the distinct hip-knee-boot chains from reference 1 while using gray wool kepi and gray jacket, TAN trousers, BROWN boots, tan rolled blanket, black back pouch, tan circular canteen and brown leather straps from reference 2. NO blue/red diagnostic color anywhere in final trousers or boots. This is a fresh complete sprite source, not an image recolor.

Pose ownership matters more than flourish:
TOP LEFT = anatomical near LEFT leg leading screen LEFT; far RIGHT leg trailing screen RIGHT.
TOP RIGHT = near LEFT leg supports; far RIGHT knee and boot flex backward screen RIGHT and lift clear of the ground.
BOTTOM LEFT = far RIGHT leg leading screen LEFT with its leading boot HIGHER in screen Y than the near LEFT trailing boot; near LEFT thigh visibly angles DOWN-RIGHT from the near hip and its knee/boot trail screen RIGHT. The near trailing leg OCCLUDES the far forward thigh at the crossing. This is the exact OPPOSITE contact of top left. Do NOT duplicate top-left leg ownership.
BOTTOM RIGHT = far RIGHT leg supports; near LEFT knee lifts FORWARD screen LEFT, boot airborne ahead LEFT. Distinct from top-right rear-right lift.
Use the exact opposite-contact and opposite-passing pose chains shown in colored reference, with final period tan/brown clothing obscuring no leg ownership. Match all four faces, kit, uniform proportions and long upright musket-bayonet grips. No firing, ground, shadows, glow, smoke, scene, lines, labels, cells or grids. Entire head-to-boot and bayonet safely within each cell with at least 45px transparent margins on EVERY edge, especially blade TOPS and boot BOTTOMS; keep the four figures comfortably smaller than the cells. Lower-row blade tips must start well BELOW the horizontal halfway seam. Do not touch any outer edge or cell seam. Fine cloth weave, weathered leather and metal, relaxed arms; no cartoon or outlines. True alpha transparency.
